name: Memory (HY Memory)
description: HY Memory — self-hosted intelligent agent memory with LLM-driven extraction, evolution chains, and multi-layer recall. Supports OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama for LLM/embedding, and Qdrant, Chroma, FAISS for vector storage.

serverUrl.label: Server URL
serverUrl.help: URL of the HY Memory server. Default: auto-start on localhost:19527

mode.label: Memory Mode
mode.help: lite: embedding only | pro: LLM extraction (default) | ultra: pro + System 2 cognitive layer with embedded Kuzu graph

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories before each agent turn

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically store conversation context after each agent turn

pythonPath.label: Python Path
pythonPath.help: Python executable, or leave default (python on Windows, python3 on Linux/macOS) to use auto-managed venv at ~/.openclaw/hy-memory-venv

autoStartServer.label: Auto-Start Server
autoStartServer.help: Automatically start the Python memory server when the plugin loads

serverPort.label: Server Port
serverPort.help: Port for the local Python memory server

topK.label: Top K Results
topK.help: Maximum number of memories to retrieve in search

searchThreshold.label: Search Threshold
searchThreshold.help: Minimum similarity score for search results (0-1)

llm.label: LLM Configuration
llm.help: Configure the LLM for memory extraction (default: OpenAI gpt-4.1-nano)

llm.apiKey.label: LLM API Key
llm.apiKey.help: API key for the LLM provider

embedder.label: Embedding Configuration
embedder.help: Configure the embedding model (default: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small)

embedder.apiKey.label: Embedder API Key
embedder.apiKey.help: API key for the embedder provider (defaults to LLM key if same provider)

vectorStore.label: Vector Store Configuration
vectorStore.help: Configure the vector database (default: Chroma local)

vectorStore.provider.label: Vector Store Provider
vectorStore.provider.help: Vector store: chroma (local, default), qdrant, faiss

serverUrl.description: URL of the HY Memory server

mode.description: SDK processing mode. ultra enables System 2 and embedded Kuzu graph (local files under ~/.hy_memory, no external graph service).

autoRecall.description: Inject relevant memories before each agent turn

autoCapture.description: Store conversation context after each agent turn

pythonPath.description: Use python (Windows) or python3 (Unix), or a full path. Default triggers auto venv.

memoryWriteTurnWindow.description: Number of agent turns between each auto-capture write (lower = more frequent writes, higher = batch more turns together)

logLevel.description: Python server log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR

llm.description: LLM provider configuration for memory extraction and reconciliation
